claims.text: Calculation methods
How the two available algorithms differ.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §2 Option 2: delta plus today's ET (the default)
docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.text: Two algorithms can produce the suggested percentage.
claims.note: The algorithm enumeration has two values, Simple and DeltaPlusTodayEt (SpatialAdjust.cs:18-22), labelled Option 1 and Option 2.

claims.text: They use different inputs and behave differently.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §2 Option 2: delta plus today's ET (the default)
docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: Option 1 uses Target VWC, measured VWC and the percent adjust Lynx holds, in the browser. Option 2 uses Target VWC, measured or modelled VWC, today's ET, the three site settings and the soil factor, on the server.

claims.text: Settings › Calculation
The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Start state. The Spatial Adjust route is /spatialadjust (app-routing.module.ts:19-23); same wording as dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: The Settings dialog, on the Calculation tab.
claims.note: Start state. Settings opens on the Calculation tab by default (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:59; sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:87), unless Review Threshold was used since the page loaded (calculation-settings/1/3).

claims.text: The gear button at the right of the toolbar opens it.
claims.note: Start state. The gear button at the right of the toolbar opens Settings (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72).

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Start state. Same prerequisite as dashboard-overview/before/1: a Spatial Adjust user on a site with TurfRad scan data.

claims.text: The dropdown labels the two methods Option 1 and Option 2, and describes neither.
claims.note: The dropdown items are "Option 1" and "Option 2" (en-us.json:367-368). The only text beside them is the field label "Suggested Percent Adjust Calculation" (en-us.json:482). There is no description or tooltip.

claims.text: The selector is hidden in production unless the site is already set to Option 1.
claims.note: The field is shown when the build is not production or when the site's saved algorithm is Option 1 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:72). Production is detected by environment name (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:127; environment.toro-prod.ts:7).

claims.text: The default is Option 2, the method that uses today’s ET.
claims.note: Sites are seeded with algorithm 1, which is DeltaPlusTodayEt, labelled Option 2 (appsettings.json:145; SpatialAdjust.cs:18-22; SitesService.cs:147, :173). The browser also falls back to it when no algorithm is loaded (sa-algorithm.service.ts:45). Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: Find the selector
Find [[Suggested Percent Adjust Calculation]], the first box on the [[Calculation]] tab.
claims.note: The selector is the first field of the Calculation pane (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:71-80). Its label is SUGGESTED_PCT_ADJ_ALGO "Suggested Percent Adjust Calculation" (en-us.json:482).

claims.text: It shows [[Option 1]] or [[Option 2]], the method your site uses.
claims.note: The dropdown offers only ALGO_SIMPLE "Option 1" and ALGO_DELTA_PLUS_TODAY_ET "Option 2" (dash-user-manager.service.ts:217-226; en-us.json:367-368), bound to the site algorithm (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:74-79).

claims.text: If the box is not there, the site uses [[Option 2]].
claims.note: On production the selector is drawn only while the site algorithm is Option 1 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:72; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:127; environment.toro-prod.ts:7). With only two algorithms, a site without the box uses Option 2, the default (calculation-methods/before/3).

claims.text: On a production site it shows only while the site uses [[Option 1]].
claims.note: On production the selector is drawn only while the site algorithm is Option 1 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:72; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:127; environment.toro-prod.ts:7). With only two algorithms, a site without the box uses Option 2, the default (calculation-methods/before/3).

claims.text: The algorithm dropdown, above the three amounts.
claims.note: Layout only.

claims.text: See what Option 1 turns off
claims.note: Step title. Option 1 is what greys the three boxes (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:83-85, :98-100, :113-115).

claims.text: Look at the three boxes below [[Suggested Percent Adjust Calculation]].
claims.note: The three boxes are Daily Max Amount, Lynx Reference Amount and Crop Coefficient, below the selector (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:82-123).

claims.text: Under [[Option 1]] they are grayed out; under [[Option 2]] you can type in them.
claims.note: Each of the three boxes is disabled while the algorithm is Option 1 and editable under Option 2 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:83-85, :98-100, :113-115). Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: If you can type in them, the site uses [[Option 2]], the method these three boxes feed.
claims.note: The three boxes are disabled only under Option 1 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:83-85, :98-100, :113-115); under Option 2 they feed the calculation (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2973-2974, :3041-3043).

claims.text: [[Option 1]] scales the percentage Lynx holds now, so it needs no ET, reference amount or cap.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: Reworded from calculation-methods/3/2 and /3/3: Option 1 multiplies the percent adjust Lynx holds by target over measured and uses no ET, reference amount or cap (sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60). Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: With Option 1 selected, the three boxes below it are grayed out.
claims.note: Figure caption (calculation-methods/3/4): the boxes are disabled with Option 1 selected. Now describes all three boxes (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:83-85, :98-100, :113-115). Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Consequence. Because Option 1 scales the current Lynx value, a station sitting at 0 percent adjust stays at 0 no matter how dry it is.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: Any ratio multiplied by 0 is 0.

claims.text: Cancel without saving
claims.note: Step title. Cancel is the second footer button (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:56-61).

claims.text: Select [[Cancel]] to close Settings without saving.
claims.note: STRINGS.CANCEL "Cancel" is in the footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:56-61; en-us.json:636). With no edits it closes the dialog at once (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:217-225).

claims.text: The dialog closes, and the table is in view again.
claims.note: With no unsaved edits Cancel emits cancel and the toolbar closes the dialog (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:217-225; sa-main-toolbar.component.html:107-112), leaving the table on screen.

claims.text: If you are asked whether to leave without saving, you changed something.
claims.note: With unsaved edits Cancel asks first, "Are you sure you want to exit without saving changes?" (en-us.json:466-467); the DISCARD_CHANGES "Discard changes" button closes the dialog and drops the edits (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:227, :235-238; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:261-270; en-us.json:390).

claims.text: Select [[Discard changes]] to drop it.
claims.note: With unsaved edits Cancel asks first, "Are you sure you want to exit without saving changes?" (en-us.json:466-467); the DISCARD_CHANGES "Discard changes" button closes the dialog and drops the edits (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:227, :235-238; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:261-270; en-us.json:390).

claims.text: Cancel, at the bottom of the Settings dialog.
claims.note: Figure caption. Cancel is the second button of the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:56-61).

claims.text: Read the Suggested column
claims.note: Step title. The Suggested column is the adjustment column of the station table (sa-dash-table.component.html:17-23).

claims.text: In the table, look down the [[Suggested]] column.
claims.note: STRINGS.SUGGESTED "Suggested" heads the column (sa-dash-table.component.html:17-23; en-us.json:1008).

claims.text: Under [[Option 2]], stations that need more than Daily Max Amount share one value, often in runs.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §1.1 Daily Max Amount is a cap

claims.note: Under Option 2 the daily maximum caps the amount, so every station above it lands on one value, which gives runs of identical suggestions (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3041-3043).

claims.text: If the values spread out with no repeats, the site may use [[Option 1]], which has no cap.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: Option 1 has no ceiling, so its suggestions spread out and can go far higher than intended on a very dry station (sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60; sa-table-card.component.html:53-62).

claims.text: Its values can go far higher than you intend on a very dry station.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: Option 1 has no ceiling, so its suggestions spread out and can go far higher than intended on a very dry station (sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60; sa-table-card.component.html:53-62).

claims.text: [[Option 2]] starts from the gap to your target and today’s ET, and Daily Max Amount caps the result.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §2.2 The chain, per station, per day

claims.note: Reworded from calculation-methods/2/2: today's ET is added to the water the delta calls for, the total is capped at the daily maximum, and the result is divided by the Lynx Reference Amount (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2931-3043). Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: Runs of identical values are a signature of the capped method.
Review the column after a switch
claims.note: Step title. Saving a new algorithm recalculates every station (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:552-554).

claims.text: After a new method is saved, look down the whole [[Suggested]] column before you push.
claims.note: Reworded from calculation-methods/5/3: review the whole Suggested column before pushing after a switch.

claims.text: The dashboard has reloaded, and every station shows a value from the new method.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: Saving a different algorithm recalculates every station and reloads the dashboard (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:552-554; sa-dashboard.component.ts:262-270, :597-598).

claims.text: If the values look the same as before, the method did not change.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: If the algorithm did not change, no recalculation is triggered (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:450, :552-554). The selector shows the saved algorithm on reopening (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:71-80).

claims.text: Reopen [[Settings]] and check [[Suggested Percent Adjust Calculation]].

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §3 Option 1: ratio of target to measured

claims.note: If the algorithm did not change, no recalculation is triggered (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:450, :552-554). The selector shows the saved algorithm on reopening (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:71-80).

claims.text: On a production site, a switch to [[Option 2]] cannot be undone here, because the selector then disappears.
claims.note: On production the selector shows only while the site algorithm is Option 1 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:72; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:127; environment.toro-prod.ts:7). Once Option 2 is saved the box is gone, so the switch cannot be undone from Settings. Same fact as calculation-methods/before/2.

claims.text: Compare the column before and after switching, not one row.
You can say which algorithm your site uses.
claims.note: On production the selector itself is the answer: if it is absent, the site is on Option 2.

claims.text: You know why Daily Max Amount is grayed out under Option 1.
claims.note: Reworded to the full label, Daily Max Amount. Both amount boxes and Crop Coefficient are disabled under Option 1, which uses no ET, reference amount or cap (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:83-85; sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60). Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.
